programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E07 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E10 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: BizPodcast: What surprises foreign journalists most about China?
programme.desc: What surprises and impresses foreign journalists the most when they visit China? Which stories about China are they most eager to share with audiences back home? What expectations do they have for the upcoming China International Import Expo? Tune in to our podcast to discover their experiences, and hear fresh perspectives and untold stories from China!

programme.title: Live promo: Small products, big industry: Meet the Canton Fair's manufacturing 'hidden champions'
programme.desc: At the 140th Canton Fair on Saturday, CGTN reporter He Jingyi joins Johann Anton Klimmer, a German tool importer and longtime Canton Fair buyer, to explore specialized sectors ranging from hardware and tools to precision components, general machinery, and lighting and electrical products. These specialized SMEs may not be household names, but their smart manufacturing capabilities, comprehensive industrial support and resilient supply chains are a vital source of strength for China's manufacturing sector - and help keep global production moving. What can seemingly ordinary products tell us about the strength of a much larger industry?

programme.title: Dubai Chambers chairman: Chinese innovation is very welcome in Dubai
programme.desc: Dubai is already home to over 6,600 Chinese companies, but the emirate wants to see more. Sultan bin Saeed Al Mansoori, chairman of Dubai Chambers, said in an interview with CGTN that Dubai welcomes innovation and creativity from China and is open to more partnerships and cooperation.

programme.title: Global Business-Asian Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: 140th Canton Fair - machines built to work with humans
programme.desc: Seventy years ago, the Canton Fair featured Chinese tea, silk and handmade goods. Today, it's about robots. Join us to see dexterous robotic hands, exoskeletons and companion robots, and how AI works alongside humans.

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how? Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art. In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: BEYOND CHINA'S Q3 ECONOMY AND 2026 OUTLOOK
programme.desc: China's economy has maintained steady performance amid strong resilience and vitality. Biztalk host Guan Xin speaks to leading economists and analysts to decipher the drive toward new growth and the accelerated advancement of structural upgrading and look ahead to the next stage of China's economy.

programme.title: China-US partnerships fueling rapid growth
programme.desc: Starbucks landed in China when coffee was a novelty. Today, 1 in 5 stores globally is there. American fast food and retail giants placed the same bet, and cashed in. Now local brands are out-executing them. The fix? Partner with Chinese private equity. Here's why it's working, and what it means for both sides.

programme.title: The green bridge between China & US
programme.desc: In 2019, Tesla was running on fumes. Shanghai handed it a lifeline, a gigafactory built in 10 months. Today, that plant produces nearly half of all Teslas using 95% local parts. That same playbook is expanding across green tech, pairing Chinese battery tech with American software. When the world's two largest economies build together, clean energy gets cheaper and faster for everyone.

programme.title: China-US: The efficiency advantage
programme.desc: The iPhone in your pocket? A global masterpiece. Apple's supply chain spans the world, with America's design expertise meeting China's manufacturing strength. Precision, speed and scale turn bold ideas into products in your hands. And this goes beyond Apple: cooperation across borders can drive innovation and growth. When the world's two biggest economies click, everyone benefits.

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances. The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances. The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: Journey of the Chili Pepper Ep.2
programme.desc: In China, the chili pepper is an indispensable winter ingredient. Since its arrival in the Ming dynasty, the spicy staple has been reshaping Chinese food culture. programme.title: The Journey of Crabs Ep.3
programme.desc: There's a saying in China: "When crab hits the table, every other dish loses its appeal." This documentary showcases the many ways crab has been prepared and enjoyed from ancient times to the present, telling the story of crab's place on Chinese dining tables.

programme.title: The Journey of Crabs Ep.4
programme.desc: There's a saying in China: "When crab hits the table, every other dish loses its appeal." This documentary showcases the many ways crab has been prepared and enjoyed from ancient times to the present, telling the story of crab's place on Chinese dining tables.

programme.title: Gulangyu Island
programme.desc: Gulangyu Island is famous for its exotic architecture. As a key trade port in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, it was a gathering point for merchants and diplomats from all over the world. This led to a variety of architectural styles being adopted on the island, including a fusion of Chinese and Western designs, as well as some typical of the Chaozhou region. These buildings, mostly over 100 years old, stand witness to China's reconnection with the outside world.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Now, Guizhou Ep.4
programme.desc: This is Guizhou's first documentary combining landscape and culture that centers on the province's natural ecosystems and karst landforms. Built around eight themes - mountains, water, dwellings, caves, bridges, accessories, songs, and the future - it uses 24 personal stories to showcase Guizhou's natural and cultural beauty. The documentary traces the area's history and culture through its cultural relics.

programme.title: Mount Wutai, Embracing the Wonders of Nature
programme.desc: Mount Wutai, in the northeastern part of Shanxi Province, is one of the Four Great Buddhist Mountains of China. It is a magnet for tourists, who are drawn here not only by its profound Buddhist cultural heritage, but also by the spectacular natural scenery. Mount Wutai is noted for its unique topography, marked by five flattened peaks. Hence the name "Wutai," or "Five Terraces." The five, each with its own characteristics and distinct shape, are Wanghai East Peak, Guayue West Peak, Jinxiu South Peak, Yedou North Peak, and Cuiyan Central Peak. Soaring into the clouds, together they resemble a magnificent work crafted by nature.

programme.title: Harbin: Moscow of the Orient
programme.desc: This episode shows Harbin's century-old Central Street brimming with exotic charm, unique Chinese Baroque architecture and authentic exquisite Russian food.We enjoy drinks at the annual Harbin Beer Festival and taste the exclusive Northern-style Manchu-Han Feast. At Volga Manor, we appreciate classic Russian architecture and folk customs from all over the world. It vividly presents Harbin, a city combining Northeast Chinese features and profound Russian cultural heritage.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, to meet more outstanding women from the cities of Hengyang and Zhuzhou. By documenting snippets of the daily lives and work of a paper-cutting artist, the director of the Hengyang Huagu Opera Troupe, and an inheritor of Liling porcelain craftsmanship, we gain vivid insights into the distinctive cultural traditions of this region.

From its Porcelain Tower - one of the Seven Wonders of the Middle Ages, to its grand city walls and ancient palaces, join us on a voyage across time to experience the echoes of history in Nanjing's storied bricks.

programme.title: Land of Diversity 2
programme.desc: This documentary explores the many relationships between humanity and the biosphere - revealing the diversity of human culture shaped by the natural world, as well as the treasures it provides.

programme.title: Between Heaven and Earth : Traveling Through Grasslands Ep.10
programme.desc: The first season of the "Wandering the World" series follows a traveler across six of China's greatest grasslands, revealing the natural beauty of their epic landscapes and the distinctive lives of the people who inhabit them.

programme.title: Gourmets Alive II Ep.5
programme.desc: Literati such as Lu You, Li Yu, Yuan Mei, and Wang Zengqi take center stage as we explore their worlds and works through the flavors and cuisine of daily life.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.5
programme.desc: Guangdong, sheltered by the Nanling Mountains, is a province where rivers cascade from hills on their way to the ocean. But before they meet the sea, they pass through another land of plenty, a place where solid earth encounters the rolling waves in a truly loving embrace - the Pearl River Delta.

programme.title: A talk with Li Kehua: Translating Chinese heritage through dance
programme.desc: In an era where dance converges with digital art and ancient myths find new life through motion capture, Li Kehua stands at the intersection of tradition and innovation. In this interview, she reflected on cross-cultural collaborations, the thrill of uncovering traditional crafts, and why she views herself not as a star, but as a humble stepping stone - helping audiences cross into a new world.

programme.title: From Farm to Table (China-France Season) Ep.1
programme.desc: Set against the backdrop of the 60th anniversary of Sino-French diplomatic relations, this program focuses on the full-chain coordination mechanism that brings food from French farms to Chinese tables, capturing the collision and fusion of two great food cultures.

programme.title: From Farm to Table (China-France Season) Ep.2
programme.desc: Set against the backdrop of the 60th anniversary of Sino-French diplomatic relations, this program focuses on the full-chain coordination mechanism that brings food from French farms to Chinese tables, capturing the collision and fusion of two great food cultures.

programme.title: Mount Wutai, Embracing the Wonders of Nature
programme.desc: Mount Wutai, in the northeastern part of Shanxi Province, is one of the Four Great Buddhist Mountains of China. It is a magnet for tourists, who are drawn here not only by its profound Buddhist cultural heritage, but also by the spectacular natural scenery. Mount Wutai is noted for its unique topography, marked by five flattened peaks. Hence the name "Wutai," or "Five Terraces." The five, each with its own characteristics and distinct shape, are Wanghai East Peak, Guayue West Peak, Jinxiu South Peak, Yedou North Peak, and Cuiyan Central Peak. Soaring into the clouds, together they resemble a magnificent work crafted by nature.

programme.title: Harbin: Moscow of the Orient
programme.desc: This episode shows Harbin's century-old Central Street brimming with exotic charm, unique Chinese Baroque architecture and authentic exquisite Russian food.We enjoy drinks at the annual Harbin Beer Festival and taste the exclusive Northern-style Manchu-Han Feast. At Volga Manor, we appreciate classic Russian architecture and folk customs from all over the world. It vividly presents Harbin, a city combining Northeast Chinese features and profound Russian cultural heritage.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, to meet more outstanding women from the cities of Hengyang and Zhuzhou. By documenting snippets of the daily lives and work of a paper-cutting artist, the director of the Hengyang Huagu Opera Troupe, and an inheritor of Liling porcelain craftsmanship, we gain vivid insights into the distinctive cultural traditions of this region.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1
programme.desc: Deze aflevering gaat over moderne wonderen in de bouwsector en de bijna bovenmenselijke kracht van hedendaagse technologie wereldwijd. Het overkoepelende thema van al deze constructies is transport: het ontwerp van snelwegsystemen, kanalen, tunnels en spoorwegen.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1
programme.desc: Zeer populaire bestemmingen voor toeristen en kunstliefhebbers, maar ook heiligdommen die het menselijk erfgoed beschermen. Welke daarvan trekken meteen onze aandacht vanwege hun architectuur, ontwerp en constructie?

programme.title: Backyard Ballistics S1
programme.desc: Jörg en Cheyenne worden uitgedaagd een rubberen kanon te bouwen! Cheyenne maakt de wielen, het frame en de krukas voor het kanon en Jörg duikt in de wetenschap achter rubber! Het is tijd om behoorlijk wat schade toe te brengen!

programme.title: Backyard Ballistics S1
programme.desc: Jörg en Cheyenne worden uitgedaagd om een speerwerper te bouwen. De twee werken samen om een machine te bouwen die zo indrukwekkend is dat Jörg denkt dat het een professionele sporter zou kunnen verslaan. Maar verslaan ze een Olympisch medaillewinaar in de finale?

programme.title: Backyard Ballistics S1
programme.desc: Jörg & Cheyenne worden uitgedaagd om een machine te bouwen die een steen over een meer kan werpen. Jörg ontwerpt een gooier die net als een arm gooit, maar niet sterk genoeg is. Zal het tweede ontwerp van Jörg krachtig genoeg zijn om het tegen een kampioen steenwerpen op te nemen?

programme.title: Rethink S1

programme.title: Rethink S1
programme.desc: We bekijken dieptewaarneming in 3D-beelden en ontdekken de Van de Graaff-generator. Heb je ooit gehoord van boventoonzingen? We leggen het uit – en nog veel meer – in Rethink.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1
programme.desc: De McVitie’s-fabriek in Carlisle, Cumbria, opent haar deuren en laat zien hoe miljoenen van ’s lands favoriete koekjes worden gemaakt — 24 uur per dag — in een van de grootste fabrieken van Groot-Brittannië én de oudste koekjesfabriek ter wereld.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1
programme.desc: Van het maken van verse spaghetti en het mengen van de geheime ingrediënten voor de saus tot gigantische geautomatiseerde kranen en de nieuwste robots: ga vandaag nog aan de slag bij de Heinz-fabriek en maak samen met de machines van morgen blikken met favoriete producten voor thuis.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1

programme.title: One in Every Japanese
programme.desc: 1 in 2 don't drink in Japan, where intense social drinking is normal. Through interviews of drinkers and non-drinkers we hear both sides, including a couple who went sober and opened a no-alcohol bar.

programme.title: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE
programme.sub-title: Braving the Rain and the Currents

programme.title: Buddies, Bwahs & Breakdowns
programme.desc: The Rabbids discover loyalty, rivalry and chaotic bonding in this heart‑tilted collection.

programme.title: Warm Fuzzies & Wild Surprises
programme.desc: Warm bonds and caring moments shine as Rabbids celebrate weddings, friendships and sweet surprise gestures.

programme.title: Bwah‑BFFs
programme.desc: Friendships form, break and explode in classic Rabbid emotional chaos.

programme.title: Critter Chaos & Creature Capers
programme.desc: Creatures big and small spark wild Rabbid antics in a lively mix of pets, farm life and animal mayhem.

programme.title: Rabbids
programme.desc: The Rabbids wiggle, stumble and go wild in a hilariously chaotic musical mess.

programme.title: Night of the Bwah‑Living
programme.desc: The Rabbids celebrate Halloween with spooky antics and completely ridiculous scares.

programme.title: Dominion: The Last Star Warrior
programme.desc: In five days the world changed. As a retired Intelligence agent turned UFO investigator races to discover the fate of the human race, an alien observer searchs for the human woman he loves.

programme.title: Enemy Within
programme.desc: When a Japanese fighter pilot crash-lands on the tiny remote Hawaiian island of Ni'ihau, he is met with courtesy and traditional Hawaiian hospitality from the locals.

programme.title: Mega Shark vs Mecha Shark
programme.desc: A new mega shark threatens to destroy humanity. The government creates an exact robotic copy of the shark, either equal to or greater than the original. Now they must fight to the death while people and whole cities get in the way.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Strap yourself in for one hilarious action-comedy starring Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton and Cate Blanchett! Escaped convicts Joe (Willis) and Terry (Thornton) are on the run and out of money.

programme.title: The Mortal Instruments: City of Bones
programme.desc: Clary Fray thinks she is just an ordinary teenager living in Brooklyn, but everything changes one night when in a downtown club she encounters the mysterious and charismatic Jace , and witnesses a shocking murder.

programme.title: Superfast
programme.desc: Undercover cop, Paul White joins Vin Serento’s LA gang of illegal street racers as they plan to double cross LA’s crime kingpin. The gang’s outrageous wheel-spinning plan is as daring as it is ridiculous and will see them towing the whole damn restaurant, at crazy speeds, half way across the city.

programme.title: Miracles: The Canton Godfather
programme.desc: A country boy becomes the head of a gang through the purchase of some lucky roses from an old lady. He and a singer at the gang's nightclub try to do a good deed for the old lady when her daughter comes to visit.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: The citizens of Spokane, a small town in Washington state, awaken to the sight of North Korean paratroopers dropping from the sky. The U.S.A. has been invaded and their hometown is the initial target. Without warning, the town is unable to fight back and finds itself under enemy occupation.

programme.title: Night Train
programme.desc: In this tightly crafted action thriller, a single mother struggling to survive agrees to run black market medical supplies in her legendary pick-up truck, "Night Train.

programme.title: Eliminators
programme.desc: Martin Parker (Scott Adkins), a highly trained former DEA agent, is hiding in the witness protection program in London with his young daughter, Carly. His world is turned upside down when a group of thugs break into his home looking for hidden contraband.

programme.title: Sabotage
programme.desc: Sabotage, an action thriller that follows one of the best assault teams on the planet, an elite special operations team of ten DEA agents.

programme.title: The Prince
programme.desc: Bruce Willis, John Cusack and Jason Patric face off in this action-packed thriller. A retired assassin is drawn back into the life he gave up when his daughter is kidnapped. To rescue her, he must confront his former rival.

programme.title: Iron Fury
programme.desc: In 1944, a young lieutenant leads a courageous group of Russian soldiers in a German POW camp, plotting a daring escape from captivity in a half-dest.

programme.title: Lost Treasure of Jesse James
programme.desc: When their family homes are threatened by a local land developer, a group of youngsters set out to locate the mysterious James brothers' treasure, a legend that may just save Ford county and allow them to keep their family homes forever.

programme.title: 500 MPH Storm
programme.desc: At 500 MPH disaster is inevitable. When an experiment goes disastrously wrong, a rash of massive hurricanes rips across North America. A scientist must get his family to safety before the hurricanes merge, creating a "hypercane" with the power to wipe America off the map.

programme.title: Saints & Soliders 2: Airborne Creed
programme.desc: On August 15th 1944, the 517th Parachute Regimental Combat Team (PRCT) jumped over the south of France. In their effort to complete the mission and rendezvous with their unit, three isolated paratroopers come across a group of French resistants in desperate need.

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: SURVIVOR is a gripping thriller about State Department employee Kate Abbott, newly posted in the American embassy in London. Kate is charged with stopping terrorists from getting into the U.S. which puts her directly in the line of fire.

programme.title: Supercell
programme.desc: Aspiring storm-chaser William is determined to continue his father's legacy by chasing the most dangerous supercell tornado ever seen.

programme.title: The Missing Sister
programme.desc: When Sharon finally tracks down her missing sister Raven, she’s elated to be back together – until she begins to suspect that Raven isn’t her sister at all, but rather an opportunistic imposter.

programme.title: A Perfect Plan
programme.desc: Four notorious thieves wake up in a fortified warehouse and are forced to commit an audacious diamond heist to win their freedom.

programme.title: Exit Speed
programme.desc: Strangers use improvised weapons, adrenaline and sheer guts to mount a defense against murderous bikers and their survival depends on doing the unthinkable - fighting for their lives.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Strap yourself in for one hilarious action-comedy starring Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton and Cate Blanchett! Escaped convicts Joe (Willis) and Terry (Thornton) are on the run and out of money.

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: In the not too distant future, the population has risen to dangerous numbers and a deadly disease has gripped the world. To combat the death toll rising, 'Arcadia' has been built as a safe disease-free haven for the privileged, where life expectancy is more than 130 years.

programme.title: The Cold Light of Day
programme.desc: THE COLD LIGHT OF DAY is an adrenaline fuelled action thriller starring British star Henry Cavill (Superman: Man of Steel, Immortals) alongside Hollywood action legend Bruce Willis (Die Hard) and Sigourney Weaver (Avatar).

programme.title: Spooks: The Greater Good
programme.desc: When charismatic terrorist Adem Qasim escapes from MI5 custody during a high profile handover, legendary operative Harry Pearce, Head of Counter-terrorism, is blamed. Disgraced and forced to resign, Harry disappears without a trace.

programme.title: Meet the Spartans
programme.desc: From the creators of Date Movie comes this tongue-in-cheek parody of the sword-and-sandal epics, dubbed MEET THE SPARTANS.

programme.title: Dear Elizabeth
programme.desc: A man who leads a dull life accidentally stalks an old college classmate, actress Elizabeth Banks, on social media. He rediscovers more of himself and the true meaning of friendship in his attempts to prove he knows her.

programme.title: Mother's Day
programme.desc: There are only a few days left before the Mother’s Day, as several families have to come to terms with how they’ll be spending the big day.

programme.title: The Pink Panther
programme.desc: When a star soccer coach is murdered and his priceless Pink Panther diamond stolen, France is in an uproar. Fortunately, Inspector Jacques Clouseau (Steve Martin) is on the case with his trusted partner Gilbert Ponton (Jean Reno). Will he seduce the pop diva, Xania (Beyoncé Knowles).

programme.title: Masterminds
programme.desc: David Ghantt is a simple man stuck in a monotonous life. Every day he drives an armored car, transporting millions with no escape in sight. The only bit of excitement is his crush Kelly Campbell, who lures him into the scheme of a lifetime.

programme.title: Bite Me
programme.desc: When Sarah, a real-life vampire, gets audited by the IRS, the last thing she expects to get out of it is a date. But James, her hopelessly romantic IRS agent, thinks she’s other-worldly.

programme.title: Zookeeper
programme.desc: In this warm-hearted comedy, the animals at one particular zoo love their caretaker, Griffin Keyes (Kevin James). But when Griffin decides the only way he can get a girl in his life is to find a more glamorous job, the animals, in a panic, break their time-honored code of silence..

programme.title: Be Cool
programme.desc: John Travolta is back as Mafia loan shark turned Hollywood Producer Chili Palmer in this sharp sequel to "Get Shorty." With an unbelievably hip all-star cast that also includes Uma Thurman, André 3000, Steve Tyler, Christina Milian and The Rock, and bursting with the hottest music in the biz.

programme.title: The Boy Downstairs
programme.desc: A writer returning to New York after a two-year stint in London, Diana (Zosia Mamet) is searching for a new residence.

programme.title: About Fate
programme.desc: When both of their engagement proposals are a bust, hopeless romantics Margot (Emma Roberts) and Griffin (Thomas Mann) find themselves together on New Year’s Eve after a bout of fateful events.

programme.title: The Pink Panther 2
programme.desc: When legendary treasures from around the world are stolen, including the priceless Pink Panther diamond, Clouseau is assigned to a dream team of international detectives who are under pressure to bring the master thief to justice before he strikes again.

programme.title: Saint Frances
programme.desc: Wayward 30-something Bridget can't seem to get a handle on her stalled career or flailing love life, until she takes a summer job nannying Frances, a precocious 6-year-old whose simple wisdoms just might set Bridget back on track.

programme.title: Above The Clouds
programme.desc: When Charlie discovers her parents have hidden her real father from her, she does what any 18-year old would - recruits a homeless guy as her 'responsible adult' and sets off to Scotland on her provisional driving licence to go find him.

programme.title: Language Lessons
programme.desc: When Adam's (Mark Duplass) husband surprises him with weekly Spanish lessons, he's unsure about where or how this new element will fit into his already structured life.

programme.title: Riddle of Fire
programme.desc: In the rolling hills of Wyoming, three mischievous children are tasked with collecting a blueberry pie from their local store.

programme.title: She's Funny That Way
programme.desc: Isabella, a young Hollywood starlet, recalls how the actions of charming Broadway director, Arnold, changed her life forever.

programme.title: The Hustle
programme.desc: Josephine Chesterfield (Anne Hathaway) is a glamorous, seductive Brit with a penchant for defrauding gullible wealthy men. Into her well-ordered world bursts Penny Rust (Rebel Wilson), an Aussie who is as free-form and fun-loving as Josephine is calculated and cunning.

programme.title: I Feel Pretty
programme.desc: A woman struggling with insecurity wakes from a fall believing she is the most beautiful woman on the planet. Her new confidence empowers her to live fearlessly, but what happens when she realizes her appearance never changed.

programme.title: Girl Most Likely
programme.desc: Kristen Wiig stars as Imogene, once a promising young New York playwright whose promise has fizzled, thanks to a crisis of confidence. Heavily in denial about being dumped by her society boyfriend, Imogene uses her skill for drama to stage an elaborate fake suicide as an appeal for his sympathy.

programme.title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
programme.desc: Big Momma is back — and this time he has big backup: his teenage stepson Trent (Brendan T. Jackson). Martin Lawrence returns as FBI agent Malcolm Turner and as Turner’s deep-cover alter-ego Big Momma.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: Lauren Mauldin (Thora Birch) is a strong-willed but misguided young woman who encourages her millions of blog followers to apply her scientific formula to all romantic relationships in order to prevent heartache.

programme.title: Girl Asleep
programme.desc: The world is closing in on Greta Driscoll. On the cusp of turning fifteen she can't bear to leave her childhood, it contains all the things that give her comfort in this incomprehensible new world.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: The Middle Ages may never be the same after street smart Jamal Walker falls into a moat at the Medieval World theme park and finds himself transported back in time.

programme.title: The Internship
programme.desc: Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) are salesmen whose careers have been torpedoed by the digital world. Trying to prove they are not obsolete, they defy the odds by talking their way into a coveted internship at Google, along with a battalion of brilliant college students.

programme.title: Holy Water
programme.desc: A rural Irish village will never be the same again after a group of bachelors hijack a truck full of Viagra pills as part of a get-rich-quick scheme. With special ops on their case, the boys hide the loot down the Church's Holy Well... only for it to seep out into the town's water supply.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: A celebrated military contractor returns to the site of his greatest career triumphs and re-connects with a long-ago love while unexpectedly falling for the hard-charging Air Force watchdog assigned to him.

programme.title: My Policeman
programme.desc: A tale of forbidden romance and changing social conventions, "My Policeman" follows the relationships between three people — policeman Tom, teacher Marion and museum curator Patrick — and their emotional and complex journey that spans decades.

programme.title: Rules Don't Apply
programme.desc: An aspiring young actress and her ambitious young driver struggle hopefully with the absurd eccentricities of the wildly unpredictable billionaire Howard Hughes, for whom they work.

programme.title: Hope Gap
programme.desc: Annette Bening, Bill Nighy and Josh O’Connor shine in William Nicholson’s intimate portrait of a family crisis.

programme.title: The Ark
programme.desc: The Ark is a retelling of the biblical story of Noah and The Ark. Noah, a farmer and family man, is instructed by an angel to build an ark in the middle of a desert in order to save both his family and the faithful from a devastating flood.

programme.title: Surprised by Oxford
programme.desc: Caro, a brilliant but emotionally guarded American student, arrives at the prestigious Oxford University with the sole focus of attaining her PhD.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Rex is based on the true-life story of young Marine Corporal Megan Leavey whose unique discipline and bond with her military combat dog saved many lives during their deployment in Iraq.

programme.title: The Vow
programme.desc: Real-life story of a newlywed New Mexico couple, Kim and Krickitt Carpenter, who were struck by tragedy shortly after their marriage. A car crash puts the wife in a coma, where she is cared for by her devoted husband.

programme.title: Between us
programme.desc: Henry and Dianne fear that settling down means giving up on their dreams. It will take the universe conspiring to keep them apart for them to realize just how much they need each other.

programme.title: I Can Only Imagine
programme.desc: It's the song that brings ultimate hope to so many...often in the midst of life s most challenging moments.

programme.title: The Odyssey
programme.desc: 1948, Jacques Cousteau, his wife and his two sons are living in paradise, in a beautiful house overlooking the Mediterranean. But all Cousteau can think of is adventure. Thanks to his invention, an independent aqualung allowing divers to breathe under water, he has discovered a whole new world.

programme.title: Emperor
programme.desc: Emperor, the son of an African king and a slave on an American plantation, can no longer tolerate the atrocities committed by whites against blacks.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: Academy Award® nominees Naomi Watts (King Kong, Mulholland Drive) and Matt Dillon (There's Something About Mary, Crash) star in this thrilling and intense story about a young couple at odds with the American Dream. Melissa Winters (Watts) works as a cashier at the bleak local convenience store..

programme.title: Bravetown
programme.desc: Josh is a lost soul with an extraordinary musical talent set on a journey to encounter what he was least expecting but undoubtedly needed most.

programme.title: Ithaca
programme.desc: When his older brother leaves to fight in WWII, 14-year-old Homer Macauley takes a job as a bicycle messenger to provide for his widowed mother and siblings.

programme.title: Life at These Speeds
programme.desc: After a teenager's friends are killed in an accident, he finds running allows him to remember them perfectly. Running, however, also brings him notoriety. Soon he finds himself caught between keeping the past alive and making new memories in the present.

programme.title: The Man Without a Face
programme.desc: A drama film about a young boy who befriends a disfigured recluse in a small coastal town; and helps him overcome his fear of society and confront his past.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Academy Award® winner Russell Crowe stars as Noah, a man chosen by God for a great task before an apocalyptic flood destroys the world.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: The Way Back is the critically acclaimed new release from renowned director Peter Weir (Master and Commander, The Truman Show), starring Colin Farrell, Jim Sturgess, Ed Harris, Mark Strong and Saoirse Ronan.

programme.title: Please Stand By
programme.desc: A young autistic woman runs away from her caregiver to boldly go and deliver her 500-page Star Trek script to a writing competition in Hollywood. On an adventure full of laughter and tears, Wendy follows the guiding spirit of Mr. Spock on her journey into the unknown.

programme.title: Genius
programme.desc: Nicole Kidman and Colin Firth star in this stirring drama about the friendship between Thomas Wolfe and editor Maxwell Perkins (who discovered F. Scott Fitzgerald and Ernest Hemingway).

programme.title: From Time to Time
programme.desc: In 1940s England, thirteen year old Tolly is sent to Green Knowe, the country estate of his grandmother, while his mother searches for any information concerning his missing in action father. Tolly soon finds that he can pass through time to witness the family stories Grandmother Oldknow tells him.

programme.title: Gook
programme.desc: Eli and Daniel, two Korean American brothers, own a struggling shoe store and have an unlikely friendship with Kamilla, a street wise 11-year-old African American girl. Kamilla ditches school, Eli stresses about the store, and Daniel tries to have a good time.

programme.title: When We Get There
programme.desc: Two brothers set out on a 2,000-mile road trip to find their father, confronting uncertain futures, fragile relationships and the meaning of family along the way.

programme.title: The Tender Bar
programme.desc: ​​From director George Clooney and based on the best-selling memoir, The Tender Bar follows an aspiring writer (Tye Sheridan) pursuing his romantic and professional dreams. From a stool in his uncle’s (Ben Affleck) bar, he learns what it means to grow up from a colorful group of local characters.

programme.title: Native
programme.desc: A signal from the other side of the universe is received by a hive-like society. Two scientists, Cane and Eva, are chosen to leave home and journey many light years to find and colonise the distant world that sent this transmission.

programme.title: Max Winslow and the House of Secrets
programme.desc: Five teens are invited to the home of an eccentric billionaire to compete in a game to win his mansion. The night takes a dark turn when they become trapped in the house and are forced to face off against each other and an evil AI entity who controls everything in the house including their fate.

programme.title: The Philadelphia Experiment
programme.desc: David Herdeg and Jim Parker are assigned a project to make an invisible radar. However, during the mission, an unusual incident occurs, transporting the two of them into the future.

programme.title: Skyman
programme.desc: The story of Carl who believes he experienced an alien encounter at 10-years-old and is now trying to reconnect with the UFO as the same location.

programme.title: Earth to Echo
programme.desc: Tuck, Munch and Alex are a trio of inseparable friends who long for adventure. One day the boys find a cryptic signal on their phones and convinced that it is part of something bigger they set out on a quest to find the source.

programme.title: Edge of War
programme.desc: A series of incidents around the world lead to greater conflict, placing the superpowers at one another's throats. Armies march, bombs rain down, soldiers storm the beaches. One family is caught up in the conflict, can they survive as total war is declared and nuclear weapons are unleashed.

programme.title: Left Behind: Rise of the Antichrist
programme.desc: After millions of people vanish and the world falls into chaos, the only light is a charismatic new leader who rises to become head of the U.N. But does he bring hope for a better future? Or is it the end of the world.

programme.title: G-Loc
programme.desc: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival.

programme.title: The Final Cut
programme.desc: In the future, a man with access to people's memories finds his life at risk when he discovers a dark secret.

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: Two immortally linked souls transcend the boundaries of time and space, one desperately searching for the answers that will save the other, and deliver the promise of eternal life.

programme.title: Arrowhead
programme.desc: A tech is sprung from prison by a revolutionary leader who promises him an opportunity to save his father from a scheduled execution if he completes a data-stealing mission. But it goes awry, stranding him on a strange alien moon.

programme.title: If You Were the Last
programme.desc: Three years into a NASA mission that has gone very wrong, astronauts Adam (Anthony Mackie) and Jane (Zoe Chao) are stuck adrift between Jupiter and Saturn in a broken-down space shuttle.

programme.title: Automata
programme.desc: Fast forward fifty years into the future, planet earth is in the midst of gradual desertification. Mankind struggles to survive as the environment deteriorates and the slow regression of the human race begins in AUTÓMATA.

programme.title: The Complex: Lockdown
programme.desc: After being tasked with saving the life of a potential bio-weapons terrorist, two London scientists find themselves in a locked-down laboratory with time - and air - running out.

programme.title: Battle for Skyark
programme.desc: In the near future the earth has become desolate and dangerous. Now inhabited by by a mysterious race of creatures, humanity has been forced to find refuge in the Skyark, a man-made city in the sky.

programme.title: Boy Makes Girl
programme.desc: After the death of his mother, a software programmer on the autistic spectrum follows his own logic in creating a robot to help care for his mother’s final unruly nursing client.

programme.title: Space Warriors

programme.title: America Now
programme.desc: On this show, we know that you don’t need more content, but you do need context. Anyone can tell you what’s happening in the news, but we hope to help you understand why it’s happening, how it’s happening, and how it affects you. This is America Now.

programme.title: Documentary
programme.desc: RT's documentaries give a varied and unique view on different aspects of life worldwide. They expose outdated myths and stereotypes, reveal intriguing history and geography, showcase varied wildlife and exquisite cuisines, introduce you to vibrant nightlife and curious customs. Original footage of historical events and sharp analysis of contemporary politics will give you a deeper understanding of what made history take this or that turn. RT's documentaries go beyond the bare facts, thoroughly investigating the issues and giving the viewer a chance to see below the surface.

programme.title: CrossTalk
programme.desc: CrossTalk is a TV debate experience which presents hot-topic discussions on politics, business, newsmakers, global trends, present-day conflicts, and dangers and challenges facing our world. programme.title: Sanchez Effect
programme.desc: Sanchez Effect is a journalistic rebellion. programme.title: Lumumba’s Africa
programme.desc: Lumumba’s Africa focuses on the past and current issues affecting the African continent; Filmed amidst the beautiful landscapes of Kenya and hosted by Professor P.L.O. programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf organizes a crew to sail to Smurfberry Island because Gargamel has killed all of the trees except one to trap the Smurfs. Gargamel follows them, but once more fails to catch them because the Witch of Smurfberry Island sends her nose-eating seagulls after them.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs learn that the mind is more powerful than matter when they are fooled by a quack's outrageously expensive miracle tonic. But Papa Smurf cures the Smurfs of their temporary naiveté and the charlatan of his villainy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: While out on a mischief-making mission to destroy the Smurfs' Happy Halloween party, Gargamel and Hogatha catch Lazy who has been accidentally turned red by Mother Nature. Papa and the Smurfs help Lazy escape while Mother Nature has Father Time help turn Lazy's red into blue just in time for the Halloween party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel is able to capture the Smurfette. Now he is going to give her a truth serum and know all of Papa Smurf' secrets… But then Gargamel makes a big mistake and gives the Smurfette a fib formula!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Grouchy, the Smurf who hates everything, doubly hates his own birthday party and goes to hide in Shadow Swamp... He is going to meet strange beings and stranger adventures while the other Smurfs search for him...

programme.title: Smurfiplication
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel creates a magic formula that duplicates everything it touches. And surprise! Suddenly there are six Brainy Smurf! This creates a few interesting situations in the Village... And also at Gargamel's!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: A dragon terrorizes the Village of the Smurfs. To put the dragon to rest, the Smurfs must find the noted Chinese traveler. Fortunately, Papa Smurf is able to understand the strange customs of the stranger, and even to speak a few words.

programme.title: The Man In The Moon
programme.desc: Sick and tired of not being appreciated, the Man in the Moon quits his job and retires on Earth, to the Village of the Smurfs. The absence of a First Quarter Moon wreaks havoc in the customs of the Smurfs, and Mother Nature and Father Time get dragged in...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: There is a prize for the cutest pet of a Smurf. Baby Smurf brings a cute, lovely, affectionate Glowing Darling, a pet anybody falls in love with… But this pet is a creation of Gargamel, the evil wizard intent on destroying the Smurfs!

programme.title: Symbols Of Wisdom
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf desperately wants to be more like Papa Smurf. Can a hair tonic be the answer? Can Gargamel be able to finally capture the Smurfs? Does wisdom really reside in a beard?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy feels up to the occasion when he starts the recipe for cookies. He is sure to win the contest: he borrowed a recipe from Papa Smurf's Book of Magic. But a big surprise, and some nasty happenings, await poor Brainy... and the whole Village.

programme.title: Secret Of The Village Well
programme.desc: Why is Clumsy Smurf waiting day and night near the Village well? What is the wish that he wants to be kept secret? How is Gargamel going to be mixed up in this mysterious affair? Is Gargamel going to catch the Smurfs at last?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs must find a bunny family to pull their float in the Autumn Carnival. Gargamel sees his chance to capture the little blue people and disguises himself as a giant bunny. Is he going to catch all the Smurfs in one fell swoop?

programme.title: Stop And Smurf The Roses
programme.desc: Wicked Chlorhydris, the sorceress, wants to destroy all love and beauty on Earth. She has to annihilate Wood Elf Grove, where the loving mute elf Laconia cares for the wild flowers. But the Smurfs are there to save the day.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Jealous of the attention Vanity Smurf receives when he breaks his toe, Jokey Smurf feigns sickness in hopes of getting recognition. Unfortunately, his ploy turns against him and instead of loving care all he receives is the proverbial pound of curse.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The nasty Stalker, who traps wild animals and sells them, has Grandpa and Wild in his clutches. Nanny and Smoogle come to the rescue, catching the Stalker in one of his own traps.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Reporter writes that Gargamel wants to be friends with the Smurfs, after hearing something out of context. Gargamel talks Reporter into taking him to Smurf Village to make his announcement in person. When Gargamel kidnaps the Smurfs, it's up to Reporter to write them out of a tight corner.

programme.title: Bungling Babysitters
programme.desc: While Handy, Brainy, and Greedy argue, Hogatha kidnaps Baby for her Formula for baby-soft skin. It's up to the quarrelling trio, plus Smoogle, to rescue Baby from Hogatha's clutches.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel throws Scruple out, so he moves in with Bigmouth. When the Smurflings help Bigmouth throw a party, Scruple captures them to get into Gargamel's good graces again. But he doesn't count on Bigmouth coming to the rescue.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel has thrown in his slime pond so much poisonous muck that the water becomes enchanted and Gargamel, after falling in, suddenly finds himself much smaller that he would wish. Actually he is going to be so small that Papa Smurf will save him!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: It must be a coincidence: just as an elephant crosses the forest and meets baby Smurf, the Smurfs decide to create a big Smurf Circus. They are going to meet the infernal sorcerer Balthazar and Baby Smurf will have a lot of fun...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel once again meets Esmeralda, the gypsy fortune-teller, and she finds a novel way of getting the gold coin that Gargamel imprudently shows her. But the Smurfs in their turn are tricked into believing there is such a thing as a good-luck tree...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: The Little Orange Horse With Gold Shoes
programme.desc: Sliding down a rainbow, a little winged horse loses a golden shoe. He meets the Smurfette and she helps him look for his lost horseshoe. They fall in love somehow, for who could be unmoved by the charm of a little orange horse... Or of a Smurfette?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: There is an evil power in the Titan's crown that Miner Smurf finds underground. And Greedy Smurf is the Smurf to fall victim to it. Then Gargamel comes up with some new schemes to destroy the Smurfs, and everything gets hopelessly tangled.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: A beautiful princess is turned into a hag and needs the whiskers of a cat and the tear of a Smurf for her magic potion. Azrael, Grouchy and Jokey unwittingly cooperate and as the magical transformation takes place, the princess frees them and they happily hurry home.

programme.title: How To Smurf A Rainbow
programme.desc: Mother Nature is too busy to conjure a rainbow for the Smurfs' festival, so Papa Smurf borrows her cookbook and mixes up the recipe himself. As there is no yellow available, they use the leprechaun's gold to produce a beautiful rainbow before Gargamel can steal it.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Brainy and Baby mix up Papa Smurf's formulas, leaving them powerless before an army of hungry locusts unleashed on the forest by Gargamel.

programme.title: Lumbering Smurfs
programme.desc: Greedy tree cutters plan to chop down King Gerard's forest while he is away on vacation. Papa Smurf disguises the Smurfs as ghosts to scare the lumberjacks who willingly surrender to the returning King and his array.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: A Hovel Is Not A Home
programme.desc: In his search for a grander hovel, Gargamel looks in the Great Book of Spells to conjure up a new home. But all of his spells backfire and that convinces him that there's no place like home!

programme.title: Speak For Yourself, Farmer Smurf
programme.desc: Farmer hides his love for Smurfette by assuming a disguise and sending her poems. When they finally meet, they are captured by Bigmouth and in their struggle to get free, they discover their mutual friendship.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel infects Hefty's heart with hate and then uses the little Smurf as a decoy for the others. Fortunately, Hefty's love overcomes his hate and he helps his little friends escape from Gargamel's clutches.

programme.title: To Smurf A Thief
programme.desc: The Smurfs and Homnibus befriend an unfortunate boy who is forced to steal for his master. Soon, the evil thief is turned over to the magistrate and the boy is happy to live with Homnibus.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Little Sickly turns into a hero when he forgets his ailments and saves the rest of the Smurfs from the deadly forget-me flowers.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs are so busy testing their individual willpower that they fail to notice Gargamel has captured Harmony. Only when Papa Smurf offers Gargamel a trick box to test his willpower does Harmony escape.

programme.title: Clumsy Luck
programme.desc: The Smurfs learn about superstition when Clumsy breaks Vanity's mirror prior to a meteor shower. When a meteor falls on Clumsy's house, everyone attributes it to bad luck, but realize the foolishness of this philosophy when they see Clumsy was not in the house at the time.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy learns it’s better to have smurfed than not to have smurfed at all when he learns his true love is really a mermaid. Can they really live with each other forever?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As the Smurfs busily build a time capsule for all of their talents, Papa Smurf frantically tries to unravel an ancient Druid riddle before disaster strikes the forest.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wonderful joy of Christmas for Baby Smurf and everyone else is almost ruined by the evil Chlorhydris who puts a spell on Mr. Nicholas to stop him from spreading holiday cheer. Fortunately, Papa Smurf and his little blue creatures break the spell and Christmas spreads over the land once more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wicked wizard Gargamel asks the sorcerer Balthazar for a recipe to capture the Smurfs. It involves kidnapping Mother Nature to stop the arrival of Spring. Luckily, the Smurfs save the day.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs discover the spirit and joy of friendly competition when they hold their first "Smurfic Games". After a near miss with the troublesome cat Azrael, the Smurfs decide they need to get into better shape. Papa Smurf suggests that the Smurfs tone their bodies as well as sharpen their athletic abilities by inaugurating the "Smurfic Games".

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clumsy Smurf's misadventures take him across a river into Pussywillow Hollow. There he meets the Pixies – charming and shapely beings whose enemies, the Wartmongers, will meet the Smurfs in some unforeseen ways.

programme.title: Gargamel's Mis-Fortune
programme.desc: Gargamel, the evil but incompetent wizard, tries to trick Esmeralda, the gypsy, into giving him a formula to catch the Smurfs. Of course the gypsy proves to be much smarter than Gargamel, and the Smurfs even more so.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The village of the Smurfs used to live without a clock. But now suddenly time becomes a precious commodity and Brainy Smurf designs a schedule to take advantage of the new Village clock... Can the Smurfs survive the attacks of time?

programme.title: Hefty And The Wheelsmurfer
programme.desc: Hefty Smurf learns what is to be handicapped when he breaks his leg. Handy Smurf creates the wheelsmurfer for him, a contraption that will give Hefty some mobility. But suddenly the evil wizard Gargamel appears on the scene.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha, the repulsive witch, captures the Smurfette. She wants to steal from the little blue beauty her golden hair. Can the Smurfs save their little female companion before it is too late? Can Hogatha grow hair like Smurfette's?

programme.title: Monster Smurfs
programme.desc: This is spook-a-Smurf eve, and all the Smurfs get ready for the fancy dress party… But Brainy Smurf gets hold of Papa Smurf's Book of Magic, and all the Smurfs are changed into hideous but funny creatures. Yet danger lurks...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hefty Smurf meets an old Trolless in the forest, and the old crone begs him to relieve her of a red spot on her nose by... giving her a good kick here and now! Hefty half-heartedly obliges... And the result is a big surprise for him!

programme.title: The Trojan Smurf
programme.desc: Gargamel, the evil wizard, has devised a new plan to capture the Smurfs: he builds a giant statue in the shape of Papa Smurf. Thus, he hopes, the Smurfs are going to drag the statue into their Village.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: There isn't a River Smurf anymore: someone has frozen it near its source. The Smurfs go to the Emerald Empress' country to see what the trouble is, and they meet the Patchwork Bear as well as the Iron Pyrites...

programme.title: Smurfette's Sweet Tooth
programme.desc: Once a year, Greedy Smurf makes a special batch of Smurfberry candy. Every Smurf receives a whole year's provision of the smurfiest candy in the whole world. But can a Smurf keep his provision for a whole year? Can the Smurfette?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This time, Gargamel feels sure of himself. Well, almost. He is going to try and finally catch the little Smurfs! Greedy Smurf's lighter-than-air pancakes are almost responsible for the Smurfs floating into Gargamel's grasp...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf's done it again. This time, in front of Papa Smurf, too. He has recited a spell that changes everything to stone. Everything including himself and all the Smurfs and the Village, and the forest around for miles... Fortunately, Peewit appears....

programme.title: The Bignose Dilemma
programme.desc: Vanity dislikes having the same blue nose as any other Smurf. What he needs is something special... Bignose, Bigmouth's fiancée, also wants to change her nose. And so, by the way, does Gargamel. Some nose exchanging takes place...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel's niece Denisa leaves her doll at his house, so he uses it to cast a controlling spell on Greedy. Gargamel nearly traps the Smurfs, until Papa turns the tables on him and returns the doll to Denisa

programme.title: Don Smurfo's Uninvited Guests
programme.desc: Thanks to Brainy, he, Nanny, and Snappy end up in a Don Smurfo storybook. If they don't get out by the last page, they'll be trapped in there forever. While Painter paints them out of danger, Papa races to prepare the potion in time.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Nobody wants to go when Clumsy leads a hike to Mount Majestic, so Papa suggests a two-team race to the summit. Brainy's team is sure they'll win, but Clumsy proves that persistence and caring are just as important as brains when he rescues Brainy's team from a falling boulder and wins the race.

programme.title: Denisa's Slumber Party
programme.desc: Sassette goes to a slumber party at Denisa's. Denisa ignores her when three big girls come too. But Denisa learns the true meaning of friendship when the bigger girls steal all her toys and Sassette helps her out.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When the emergency call rings, all the Smurfs in the Village drop what they are doing and run to hear the news. But when Vanity Smurf calls for an assembly so that the Smurfs can admire his new hat, it is too much. They send him on his way out of the village, and Vanity has the bad luck of meeting Lofty, the Elf, who suggests a horrible mud bath...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What is that strange talking frog that Morlock the Wizard sends all of Prince Theodore's soldiers to catch? Is it a demon frog, as he says, or something else? Truth will out when Smurfette and the Smurflings meet the frog. They help to change this frog back into Prince Theodore himself, for he's been the victim of a spell cast by Morlock.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Every 500 years, Castle Captor appears and abducts innocent travelers. Grandpa takes off in his balloon for the castle, where he meets Nanny Smurf, who’s been missing for 500 years. They have only a short time to escape, or they’ll become permanent guests!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: Land Of The Lost And Found
programme.desc: Hefty, Handy, and Brainy lose Papa's telescope and Scour, the Lord of Lost and Found, finds it. The Smurfs say they'll trade anything to get it back, so Scour takes their most valuable possessions – handiness, heftiness and braininess. They journey to his domain to retrieve what was lost.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil warlock Nemesis shows up at the Wizards' Library to steal the knowledge from the Archives of Evil and so get the Long Life Stone. But it's Brainy who inadvertently saves the day when he switches Greedy's cookbook and Papa's spell book.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Roommates Smurfette and Nanny are getting on each other's nerves, so the time has come for Nanny to have a house of her own. As Nanny and Smurfette trek off to find a house-warming plant, the others design the Smurfliest house for her.
